text: dsh-mobile 为 DSH 提供手机操作能力，通过 MobileService 接入工具和上下文。agent 可读取结构化屏幕元素、打开应用、点击元素或文字、输入草稿并返回。默认 mock provider 离线可用；真实设备模式通过 mobile-mcp 连接 Android 设备，适合需要让 DSH 查看手机状态并导航应用的场景。

dsh-mobile adds mobile controls to DSH through MobileService. Agents can inspect structured screen elements, open apps, tap targets, enter drafts, and go back. The mock provider works offline; real Android devices use mobile-mcp. It suits workflows that need phone inspection and app navigation.
想让 DSH agent 看看手机当前显示什么。
能不能让助手打开手机上的某个应用？
我希望用屏幕上的文字来点击按钮。
让 DSH 帮我在手机输入框里写一段草稿。
手机应用里点错页面了，怎么返回上一层？
需要让 agent 根据手机界面元素进行操作，而不是看截图。
I want my assistant to inspect the current phone screen.
Can DSH open an app and tap a visible control on my device?
dsh-mobile 的功能「读取手机屏幕」：调用 mobile_observe 获取归一化 UI 元素列表、设备与屏幕信息，并以紧凑格式返回给 agent。
dsh-mobile 的功能「打开应用」：mobile_open_app 按应用包名或 provider 支持的别名启动应用，并提示后续重新观察确认结果。
dsh-mobile 的功能「点击界面元素」：mobile_tap 使用最近观察到的元素 ID、精确文本或坐标定位并点击屏幕目标。
dsh-mobile 的功能「输入草稿」：mobile_type 将指定文本输入当前可编辑位置；工具定义为草稿输入，不会提交或发送。
dsh-mobile 的功能「返回上一页」：mobile_back 调用设备返回操作，并建议再次读取屏幕确认导航结果。
dsh-mobile 默认使用离线 mock provider；真实设备模式需配置 mobile-mcp 的服务入口，且需要 Android emulator 或已连接设备才能工作。
dsh-mobile 的 mobile-mcp 适配器无法查询前台应用，因此该 provider 返回的屏幕状态不包含 app 信息；界面元素仍可用于观察和交互。

**Give your DeepSeek Harness agent eyes and hands on a phone.**
dsh-mobile is a mobile device capability plugin: the agent observes the live screen as a
structured UI tree (no screenshots, no vision model, zero image tokens) and acts through
five safe tools — observe, open app, tap, type (draft only), back.

dsh-mobile README · Why not screenshots?：Most phone-agent stacks feed screenshots to a vision model: slow, expensive, and brittle.
dsh-mobile drives apps from the native **accessibility tree** via
[mobile-mcp](https://github.com/mobile-next/mobile-mcp):

- **Fast** — one observe returns the full UI element list in milliseconds
- **Cheap** — structured text, no image tokens
- **Reliable** — semantic taps by element id/text, not fragile coordinates

dsh-mobile README · Status：- ✅ **Phase 1** — MobileService capability seam, mock provider, 5 agent tools, context/policy contracts
- ✅ **Phase 2** — MobileMcpProvider over the MCP protocol, verified on a real Android emulator
  (2026-08-22, Medium_Phone_API_36.0 / emulator-5554: devices → observe (28 elements) →
  openApp Settings → observe (69 elements) → semantic tap 'Apps' → ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND error path → back)
- ⬜ **Phase 3** — `mobile_swipe`, screenshot observation, foreground-app awareness (ADB provider), multi-device
- ⬜ **Phase 4** — Tier-3 send capability (approval-gated), retrieved memory (contacts/conversation summaries)
dsh-mobile README · Status：**Out of scope**: auto-chatting, contact memory, WeChat/RED and other app-level automation.

dsh-mobile README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `mobile_observe` | Foreground app + normalized UI element list (read-only) |
| `mobile_open_app` | Launch an app by package name or alias |
| `mobile_tap` | Tap by element id / exact text (coordinates as last resort) |
| `mobile_type` | Enter a **draft** only — never sends, submits, or publishes |
| `mobile_back` | Press the device back button |

dsh-mobile README · Safety by design：Externally consequential actions (sending messages, posting, paying, deleting accounts)
are **denied by policy** unless the user explicitly authorizes them:

- **Tier 0–4 permission model** — guard-level hard rejects + pre-execute asks
- `mobile_type` enters drafts only; publishing is out of reach of the tool surface
- Every tool result is structured and auditable

Optional configuration (the plugin row in the profile's `cordis.yml`):

```yaml
- id: mobile
  name: dsh-mobile
  config:
    provider: mock           # mock (default, offline) | mobile-mcp (real device)
    deviceId: emulator-5554  # optional, mobile-mcp only; defaults to first online device
    announceToAgent: true    # announce the plugin in the system prompt
    enabled: true
```
